programme.title: Talking Pictures

programme.title: The Richard Burton Diaries
programme.desc: Mali Harries narrates a documentary revealing the contents of hellraising actor Richard Burton's recently published diaries, providing a unique opportunity to reassess the man behind the myth.

programme.title: Railway Walks
programme.desc: Tin and copper once made the area around Redruth the richest patch of land in the country. They inspired great engineering feats and pioneering tramways, the forebears of the rail empire. Julia has her work cut out as she crosses an entire country, winding past Cornwall's crumbling engine houses and following a railway that hasn't operated for 140 years.

programme.title: Imagine...
programme.desc: Revealing the darker side of one of Britain's most original and inventive artists. A sculptor working with found materials, Cornelia Parker creates beauty from acts of brutality: an exploded shed, piles of squashed silver, the charred remnants of a burnt church suspended in time.

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Yng nghanol y goedwig, allwch chi glywed yr holl synau gwahanol? Ma Harmoni, Melodi a Bop eisiau gwybod pwy sy'n swnio fel ffliwt. Harmoni, Melodi and Bop wonder who makes a hooting sound.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: A fydd Breian yn barod i helpu ei ffrindiau er y bydd rhaid iddo drochi? Breian the Ferry is so fastidious and paranoid about getting dirty that he won't join in with anything the others are doing.

programme.title: Jambori
programme.desc: Hello and welcome to Jamborî! Come and join Jam on a musical adventure full of interesting sounds and colourful pictures where shadows dance, robots play and fruits move to the music.

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop
programme.desc: Ar yr antur popwych heddiw mae'r ffrindiau yn dysgu am saith rhyfeddod Pentre Papur Pop! The friends are learning about the seven wonders of Pop Paper City.

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Betsan eisiau gwybod mwy am asparagws, felly mae Hywel y ffermwr hud yn ei thywys i Fferm Fach i ddangos iddi sut mae'n cael ei dyfu. Betsan wants to discover more about asparagus, so Hywel the magic farmer takes her to Fferm Fach.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Mae'r Whws yn clywed Gorila Whw'n canu, ond pan mae nhw'n gofyn iddo ganu eto dydi o ddim yn gallu. The Woohoos hear Gorilla Woohoo singing, but when they ask him to sing again, he can't.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Dewch ar antur gyda ni i gwrdd ag anifeiliaid bach y byd. Yn y rhaglen hon cawn gip-olwg ar y chameleon a'r neidr. Taking a close a peek at the two animals, the chameleon and the snake.

programme.title: Dreigiau Cadi
programme.desc: Bob blwyddyn mae sioe arbennig yn Abergynolwyn lle gall pobl ddangos y llysiau maen nhw wedi'u tyfu. Eleni, mae Cadi yn cystadlu gyda'i moron. Cadi competes with the carrots she has grown.

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Gem ffon yw Hela Pryfed Estron. Mae Norman, Mandy, Sara a Jams yn mwynhau chwarae, efo cystadleuaeth daer rhyngddyn nhw a Siarlys a Meic Flood. The gang play the Alien Bug Hunt phone game.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Newyddion mawr y dydd yw fod siarc wedi ei weld oddi ar arfordir Cymru ym Mhenarth. The big news of the day is - a shark has been seen off the coast of Penarth, Wales!

programme.title: Cywion Bach
programme.desc: Gair heddiw yw 'ci' ac mae rhaglen heddiw'n llawn cwn - ci gwlyb, ci smotiog, ci wedi ei baentio. Today's word is 'ci' and the programme is full of wet dogs, spotty dogs and a painted dog.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: The animated tales of a little bunny and his friends.

programme.title: Awyr Iach
programme.desc: Heddiw, bydd Huw a'r criw yn dysgu sut i fforio am fwyd, ac fe fydd Ysgol Canol y Cymoedd yn ymarfer tuag at eu diwrnod mabolgampau. Today, Meleri and Owen search for dinosaur fossils.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Heddiw mae Pablo wedi mynd i'r traeth! At the beach Pablo refuses to wear suncream so Mum tells him to stay in the shade. Can the animals persuade him to come out and play in the sunshine?

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae Harri'n cael galwad i ddweud fod gan Elin Fflur deiar fflat ar ei char, felly ffwrdd a fo i Langefni i'w drwsio. Harri gets a call to say that Elin Fflur's car has a flat tyre.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'r Pitws Bychain yn gweld gwrychoedd sydd wedi eu torri'n wahanol siapiau. On the way home, the Wee Littles find some interesting shaped hedges. But they would like to shape a shrub too.

programme.title: Patrôl Pawennau
programme.desc: Mae Marlyn y Merlen yn helpu achub y Pawenfws ar ôl i'r Pawenlu ei hachub hi. A nervous pony gets lost when it's spooked, and then the Paw Patroller gets stuck during the pony's rescue.

programme.title: Odo
programme.desc: Cartwn hyfryd am gwdihw bach o'r enw Odo a'i ffrindiau yn y goedwig. A little owl called Odo and his woodland friends aim to combat the rise of anxiety in pre-school children by teaching them self-efficacy and to believe in themselves.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae Crwbi y crwban yn dangos i Joni rhinwedd pwyllo, a daw hynny'n allweddol i drechu'r dihiryn Beti Bowen. Jet-boy's turtle, Crwbi, shows him the key to defeating the villain Beti Bowen.

programme.title: Deian a Loli
programme.desc: Mae Deian a Loli yn mynd am antur i wlad y Da-das, gwlad lle mae popeth wedi ei wneud o losin! Deian and Loli go on an adventure to Gwlad y Da-das, a land where everything is made of candy!

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae'r Tralalas yn gwybod bod ailgylchu yn beth da i'w wneud ac yn hwyl hefyd. The Tralalas know that recycling is good to do and fun too. Bop recycles something into a puppet.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Cen Twyn is repairing Twt's funnel and has promised Twt that once repaired it will be louder than ever. A very excited Twt can't wait to give it a go and although not fully fixed, he blows his horn and it goes flying off, landing in the sea.

programme.title: Jambori
